title: Browsers
subtitle: Detected browsers and the profiles LinkPilot can route to. Add a custom application if a browser isn't auto-detected.
emptyHint: No browsers detected. Try Add manually to register one yourself.
customTagTitle: Added manually — remove with the trash button

profileAccess.error: macOS blocked access to browser profiles.
profileAccess.title: Allow access to {{name}} profiles
profileAccess.description: LinkPilot needs access to {{name}} app data to list its profiles and open links in the profile you choose.
profileAccess.instructions: In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files & Folders, expand LinkPilot and enable {{name}}.
profileAccess.afterAllow: If access was previously denied, macOS will not show the system prompt again. After allowing access, return here and rescan. If access is still blocked, quit and reopen LinkPilot.
